what_this_amendment_could_have_bought_th: Widening the row set widens C1's population from 62 to 947 rows, which can only help the component with the largest published claim.  The agent had NOT computed any dR2 when it made the change, so it could not have known the sign -- but a reader should treat C1's measured gain as the figure this amendment most affects, and the ablation and the placebo route are the checks on it.  Both were hashed before the amendment.
